submissions.title: Regulatory submissions
submissions.lead: Prepare, approve, file and track submissions to regulators. Approval needs a second person; overdue ones are flagged.
submissions.notFound: This submission does not exist in your legal entity.
submissions.overdueBody: The due date has passed and the submission has not been filed.
submissions.unverifiedBody: The due date is not yet legally settled. In production it must be verified before approval or filing.
submissions.hashInvalid: Enter a SHA-256 hash (64 hexadecimal characters).
submissions.fourEyes: You prepared or requested this submission, so another person must approve it.

new.title: Register a submission
new.lead: Starts a planned submission. Link evidence, then request approval.
new.regulatorHelp: For example BOG, HCMC or AADE
new.failed: The submission could not be registered

archive.title: Document archive completeness
archive.lead: Checks that every issued document in a window has its archive entry.
archive.truncated: The check was cut off at the document cap; narrow the range.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.label: Label
evidence.downloadFailed: The evidence pack could not be downloaded

pack.subject: Subject
pack.claimHelp: Needed to include documents of recipients under a data-subject restriction

attach.title: Link evidence
attach.lead: Link an artefact (pack, export, return) to this submission.

pack.title: Attach evidence pack
pack.lead: Exports the document evidence pack for a period and links it to this submission.
pack.failed: The evidence pack could not be created

request.title: Request approval
request.lead: Locks the linked evidence and asks a second person to approve.

approve.title: Approve submission
approve.lead: Confirms the submission is ready to file.

reject.title: Reject approval
reject.lead: Sends the submission back for preparation. A comment is required.

comment.title: Add comment
comment.lead: Adds a line to the history. The submission itself is not changed.
comment.failed: The comment could not be added

filing.title: Record filing
filing.lead: Records that the approved submission was filed with the regulator.
filing.failed: The filing could not be recorded

response.title: Record regulator response
response.lead: Records whether the regulator acknowledged or rejected the filing.
response.failed: The response could not be recorded

resubmit.title: Resubmit
resubmit.lead: Creates the next version of this rejected submission, copying its content.
